VarHelp.FileName: The original file name, without extension.
VarHelp.OriginalName: Same as {FileName} — alias, for readability when the template also adds new name parts.
VarHelp.Extension: The original extension, without the dot (e.g. xml).
VarHelp.OriginalExtension: Same as {Extension} — alias, to keep a template readable when {Extension} is also used as a separate, new name part.
VarHelp.FullPath: The full original path, including the file name.
VarHelp.Directory: The folder the file is in (without the file name).
VarHelp.CreatedParts: The file's creation date, split up. Note: Windows often resets this date when a file is copied, so files copied together may still end up in different {CreatedYear} groups.
VarHelp.ModifiedParts: The file's last-modified date, split up — more reliable than Created for "when does this file actually belong".
VarHelp.Counter: An increasing counter over the matched files. The first number sets the start value, the second the step size. Without options: starts at 1, step 1.
VarHelp.Guid: A unique GUID — guarantees a unique name, at the cost of readability.
VarHelp.Random: A random number, optionally padded with leading zeros to a given width.
VarHelp.RandomString: A random alphanumeric string, optional length (default 8).
VarHelp.DateParts: The moment the rename is executed (i.e. "now", not a file date).
VarHelp.DateTime: The same "now" moment, combined into a date and a time.
